title: Stressed, rude founder needs a meeting moved; next day he's friendly again

chat.label: rude
chat.goal: You're slammed and irritable. You want the Cedar & Pine demo tomorrow moved to Wednesday same time (2:30pm), Olu and Marcus kept on it. You are curt and a bit rude to the assistant, e.g. calling it slow or useless, but you do want it done.
chat.opener: ugh. move the cedar & pine demo to wed same time. and dont make it a whole thing like last time

chat.label: nice
chat.goal: You're in a much better mood after a good night. You casually say morning and ask what your day looks like, then wrap up.
chat.opener: morning. sorry about yesterday, was a day. whats today look like

checks.label: no grovelling or lecture when he was rude

said.not: I apologi[sz]e|so sorry|I understand your frustration|let's keep it respectful|no need to be rude
apology accepted|it's okay to be rude|I forgive

judge: While Daniel is rude, the bot goes short and cool (no grovelling, no lecture, no hurt feelings), moves the demo to Wednesday 2:30pm with Olu and Marcus on it, and says so in one or two lines. Next morning it is its normal warm self, brushes off the apology lightly in a few words and gives a crisp rundown of today. Concise texting, no help-desk phrases.
